title: SKILL.md Frontmatter Schema
description: Required frontmatter for every SKILL.md. Uses the agentskills.io fields plus a small metadata block for publishing and product discovery.

name.description: Lowercase hyphenated skill name. Must exactly match the directory name.

description.description: Trigger description. Used by IDE discovery and skill routing. Must be specific enough for an agent to decide whether to activate this skill — long enough to give confident routing signals, short enough to stay a cheap standing cost in agent context.

compatibility.description: Short note on the environment or tooling this skill assumes (MCP tools, CLI presence, tenant scopes).

license.description: agentskills.io standard field. License name or reference to a bundled license file.

allowed-tools.description: agentskills.io standard field (experimental). Space-separated string of pre-approved tools, e.g. 'Bash(git:*) Read'.

product_family.description: Primary product family the skill covers.
